Class ValueEncodingHelpers

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.helper.ValueEncodingHelpers
public class ValueEncodingHelpers extends Object
Helpers for encoding materialized values into strings, and decoding them again. Values are encoded as a single SNBT compound, optionally gzipped and base64-encoded behind a prefix. Only materialized values can be encoded and decoded, as other values refer to state that is meaningless, or even abusable, in another world.

    • validateMaterialized

      public static void validateMaterialized(net.minecraft.nbt.Tag tag) throws ValueEncodingHelpers.ValueEncodingException
      Check that the given tag only holds materialized state. Non-materialized values refer to a position in a world, which would allow a handcrafted value to read blocks that the player has no access to.
      Parameters:
      tag - An encoded value.
      Throws:
      ValueEncodingHelpers.ValueEncodingException - If the tag holds anything that is not materialized.
